name: Neeraj Kumar
summary: Computer Science undergraduate at IIIT Una specializing in AI/ML systems and Backend Engineering. Architected autonomous agentic workflows, context-grounded RAG pipelines, and deep learning diagnostic systems delivering up to 99.23% precision and processing 72K+ records. Proficient in Python, LangGraph, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL with end-to-end cloud deployment experience.

education.degree: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering

education.institution: Gurukul Shikshan Sansthan Sr. Sec. School

projects.name: ResumeWeaver
projects.title: Automated Job Discovery & Resume Generation Pipeline
bullets: Built an end-to-end AI pipeline that discovers and ranks job postings against a skill profile, automatically listing matched opportunities in Google Sheets and triggering tailored resume generation for roles exceeding a 60% relevance threshold.

Engineered a FastAPI backend with asynchronous LangGraph orchestration and a 3-agent CrewAI review pipeline for ATS compatibility, technical accuracy, and readability before generating the final PDF resume.

Integrated Activepieces, Google Sheets, and Google Drive to automate job discovery, tracking, resume delivery, and workflow execution, eliminating repetitive manual processing across the application pipeline.
Implemented a submit-poll-retrieve job-queue architecture to reliably handle multi-step LLM workflows without HTTP timeouts and coordinate asynchronous resume generation.

projects.name: PneumoScan AI
projects.title: Chest X-Ray Classification & RAG
bullets: Developed a 2-stage medical diagnostic system combining deep transfer learning with RAG to provide context-grounded clinical explanations.
Overhauled system architecture, boosting precision to 99.23%, AUC to 0.9858, and accuracy to 90.17% by migrating from custom CNNs to fine-tuned MobileNet.
Engineered retrieval mechanisms indexing official NICE clinical guidelines into FAISS using 512-token chunking and 768-dimensional BAAI embeddings.

projects.name: IPL Match Win Prediction ML Pipeline & Deployment
bullets: Designed and executed an end-to-end data pipeline processing 72,413 delivery records across 756 IPL matches with automated cleaning and feature engineering.
Developed a Scikit-learn predictive modeling pipeline evaluated on an 80/20 train-test split, achieving 80.31% test accuracy for real-time win probability estimation.
Deployed an interactive Streamlit web application featuring real-time win probability visualizations driven by Pickle model serialization.

achievements: Solved 200+ Data Structures and Algorithms problems across coding platforms.
Deployed 3+ production-grade AI/ML applications to public cloud infrastructure using Streamlit Cloud and AWS Elastic Beanstalk.
